summary_sections.title: What this assessment measures
summary_sections.copy: RIASEC measures your interest strength across different work activities, such as hands-on work, analysis, expression, support, persuasion, and organization.

summary_sections.title: What this assessment does not measure
summary_sections.copy: It does not measure ability, personality identity, career success, income, job performance, or hiring risk.

summary_sections.title: How 60Q and 140Q relate
summary_sections.copy: 60Q describes the basic interest structure. 140Q separates task, environment, and role-responsibility clues. 140Q is more contextual, not more accurate, and it does not overturn 60Q.

summary_sections.title: How to read scores
summary_sections.copy: 0-100 is a within-form interest-strength conversion. It is not a population percentile and it is not an ability score.

summary_sections.title: How to read occupation examples
summary_sections.copy: Occupation examples only show where some activities may appear. When source rows are not attached, they must be labeled as content examples.

summary_sections.title: How feedback is used
summary_sections.copy: Saved, excluded, disagreement, and experiment feedback affect exploration paths only. They do not change assessment scores, report snapshots, or share content.

summary_sections.title: Response quality boundary
summary_sections.copy: The 60Q form currently declares only minimum response-completion rules. It does not produce a strong low-quality judgment.

summary_sections.title: Report snapshots
summary_sections.copy: A formal report is bound to the snapshot created when it was generated. Sharing, PDF, and history surfaces should read the same auditable result.

career_interest_only.label: Measurement scope
career_interest_only.copy: RIASEC describes interest in work activities. It does not measure ability, personality identity, work values, psychological state, income potential, or career success probability.

not_career_recommendation.label: Occupation examples
not_career_recommendation.copy: Occupation examples need activity and task explanations. They are content examples, not matches, recommendations, rankings, or job-fit judgments.

same_scale_not_same_score_space.label: Score space
same_scale_not_same_score_space.copy: riasec_60 and riasec_140 share the RIASEC model but have different raw-score spaces. Raw-score changes across these forms are not comparable by default.

riasec_140_contextual_not_more_accurate.label: 60Q and 140Q
riasec_140_contextual_not_more_accurate.copy: 140Q provides more contextual clues about interest in everyday work. This does not make its answers more accurate.

content_examples_not_registry_match.label: Example provenance
content_examples_not_registry_match.copy: Without a reviewed registry source, occupation examples must be labeled content_example_not_registry_match.

feedback_no_score_mutation.label: Feedback
feedback_no_score_mutation.copy: User feedback enters the exploration layer only. It does not overwrite measured_holland_code, dimension scores, or formal report snapshots.

snapshot_bound_report.label: Report snapshots
snapshot_bound_report.copy: Formal reports, sharing, PDF, and history use the report snapshot as their display authority.

quality_boundary_60q_minimal.label: 60Q response quality
quality_boundary_60q_minimal.copy: 60Q currently declares minimum answer-completion rules only. It does not make a strong low-quality judgment.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Not an ability or personality measure
runtime_disclaimers.copy: RIASEC does not measure ability, personality, values, or long-term career outcomes.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Not for hiring or screening
runtime_disclaimers.copy: RIASEC is not for hiring, promotion, exclusion, or employment screening.

runtime_disclaimers.label: No raw-score comparison across forms
runtime_disclaimers.copy: Raw-score changes between 60Q and 140Q are not comparable by default.

runtime_disclaimers.label: 140Q does not claim greater accuracy
runtime_disclaimers.copy: 140Q provides more specific contextual clues about interest.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Examples are not matches
runtime_disclaimers.copy: Occupation examples are content examples, not occupation-database matches or job recommendations.

runtime_disclaimers.label: Feedback limits
runtime_disclaimers.copy: Feedback does not change measured_holland_code, scores, or formal report snapshots.
